name: Everything I Wish Somebody Had Told Me Before I Bought My stone Floor
short: Everything I Wish Somebody Had Told Me Before I Bought My Stone Floor Thinking about natural stone but don’t know where to start? I’ve spent years supplying, laying, repairing and looking after stone floors, and this is the practical advice I wish somebody had given me before I started. 30 pages of straight-talking advice about choosing your stone, measuring, preparation, underfloor heating, laying, grouting, sealing, cleaning, repairs, choosing an installer and avoiding expensive mistakes. I’ve kept it simple. I’m not here to bamboozle you or frighten you into buying anything. Just the things that actually matter when you’re spending your money on a floor you’ll probably live with for decades. £10 — instant PDF download.

name: Worcester Limestone Flooring – Timeless Stone Collection
short: Worcester limestone flooring is a warm, characterful 20mm limestone with rich orange and yellow tones softened by natural grey shelly detailing. Supplied in 500mm and 600mm widths with random lengths, Worcester offers a honed finish with gently tumbled edges for a timeless, hard-wearing floor suited to both traditional and contemporary interiors.

name: Newbury Limestone – Timeless Stone Collection
short: Newbury limestone flooring from the Timeless Stone Collection features soft biscuit beige tones with subtle grey flecking and gently tumbled edges. Supplied in random length flagstone format and large format tiles, Newbury offers a refined and timeless natural stone finish.

name: Epsom Limestone – Sandblasted Flagstone Flooring
short: Epsom limestone flooring features a refined sandblasted finish with soft biscuit tones and subtle grey shelly detail. Available in 400mm, 500mm and 600mm random lengths at 18mm thickness, Epsom offers a lightly textured alternative to honed limestone finishes.

name: Bellissimo Porcelain Tile  600x1200mm
short: Bellissimo is a large-format 600x1200mm porcelain tile available in Pink and Beige. Designed to create a refined, contemporary finish, this durable porcelain tile is suitable for walls and floors. 1.39 tiles per m². £50 per m² inc VAT.

name: Barcelona Porcelain Feature Tile
short: Barcelona is a 223mm x 223mm patterned porcelain feature tile available in Azur, Grigio and Nero. Designed to bring Mediterranean character to kitchens, bathrooms and feature floors, this durable porcelain tile is suitable for both walls and floors. 20 tiles per m². £45.48 per m² inc VAT.

name: Athens Marble Effect Porcelain Tile
short: Athens Marble Effect Porcelain Tile combines the timeless elegance of natural marble with the strength and practicality of porcelain, making it perfect for stylish, low-maintenance interiors.

name: Arbia Porcelain Tile
short: Contemporary porcelain tile available in multiple large formats. Durable, low maintenance and suitable for underfloor heating.

name: Alba Ivory Porcelain Tile 600x400mm
short: Alba Ivory porcelain tile in a 600x400mm format, featuring warm ivory tones with a subtle stone-effect finish. A versatile and durable porcelain tile suitable for walls and floors.

name: Alba Silver Porcelain Tile 600x400mm
short: Alba Silver porcelain tile in a 600x400mm format, featuring soft silver-grey tones with a subtle stone-effect finish. A durable and low-maintenance porcelain tile suitable for walls and floors.

name: York Limestone Flagstone Flooring – Timeless Stone Collection
short: York limestone flagstone flooring is a substantial 22–23mm natural stone with warm autumnal tones and traditional cathedral-style character. Supplied in 400mm, 500mm and 600mm random lengths, as well as larger format options and opus patterns, York features a brushed and lightly honed surface with hand-cut edges.

name: Wetherby Limestone Flooring – Antiqued Heritage Flagstone
short: Wetherby limestone flooring is an antiqued 15mm natural stone with warm biscuit tones and enhanced fossil character. Acid-washed to gently expose shell detail, Wetherby is supplied in 500mm and 600mm random lengths with softly tumbled edges for a traditional flagstone appearance.

name: Southwell Limestone Flagstone Flooring – Timeless Stone Collection
short: Southwell limestone flagstone flooring is a substantial 22–23mm natural stone with elegant neutral grey tones and a brushed, lightly honed surface. Supplied in 400mm, 500mm and 600mm random lengths, Southwell features hand-cut edges and a traditional flagstone character ideal for larger spaces.

name: Ludlow Flagstone Limestone Flooring – Timeless Stone Collection
short: Ludlow limestone flagstone flooring is a substantial 22–23mm thick natural stone with deep grey tones and a textured riven surface. Supplied in 500mm and 600mm random lengths, Ludlow delivers an authentic worn flagstone appearance with brushed finishing and hand-cut edges.

name: Kelso Limestone Flooring – Timeless Stone Collection
short: Kelso limestone flooring is a refined 15mm grey natural stone with warm undertones, subtle fossil detailing and fine calcite veining. Supplied in 500mm and 600mm widths with random lengths, Kelso features a honed surface and lightly tumbled edges for a calm, balanced finish.

name: Bath Limestone Flooring – Timeless Stone Collection
short: Bath limestone flooring is a refined 15mm natural stone featuring warm creamy tones with subtle white shell flecks and gentle tonal variation. Supplied in 600mm random lengths, 600x900mm and 900x900mm formats, Bath offers a clean honed finish with lightly tumbled edges for a timeless, elegant look.

name: Moleanus Blue
short: Blue undertone and an even spread of grey/blue fossils. These tiles come with bevelled edges for easy grouting.

name: Goodwood Sandstone Flagstone Flooring – Timeless Stone Collection
short: Goodwood sandstone flagstone flooring is a 20mm natural stone with soft muted off-white and weathered grey tones. Supplied in 600mm widths with random lengths up to approximately 900mm, Goodwood features a lightly brushed and honed surface that creates a gently riven, traditional flagstone appearance.

name: Sandown Limestone Flooring – Timeless Stone Collection
short: Sandown limestone flooring is a warm 20mm natural stone characterised by biscuit and oatmeal tones with subtle fossil detailing. Supplied in 500mm and 600mm widths with random lengths, Sandown features a honed and lightly brushed surface with gently tumbled edges for a rich, established appearance.

name: Chepstow Limestone Flooring – Timeless Stone Collection
short: Chepstow limestone flooring is a warm cream 15mm honed natural stone with abundant fossil shell detailing and gently tumbled edges. Supplied in 600mm widths with random lengths up to approximately 900mm, Chepstow offers a classic, established appearance suited to both period and contemporary interiors.
